error.message: app 'ForgeKit Studio' has no accessibility window; make sure the app has a visible window, then retry with --restore-window.

nextSteps: Run `orca computer list-windows --app <app> --json` and target one of the listed windows.
If the app is listed but no usable window is visible, retry observation once with `--restore-window`.
If no window is listed, open or focus the app first; `orca computer` does not launch closed desktop apps.
